findings.title: The generated decision surface misorders the interleaved Wave authority chain
findings.reproduction: Open planning/review-site/enablers/ECR-0005.html and inspect the table labelled Ordered Wave authority chain. It renders adopted W1.A05 before terminal reserved W1.A04 because tools/plan_review_site.py emits authorityChain.orderedAmendments and authorityChain.reservedAmendments as separate groups. This conflicts with the packet and proposal sequence W1.A01, W1.A02, W1.A03, reserved W1.A04, adopted W1.A05.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant R02 candidate that renders one canonical immutable-identity-ordered amendment sequence, preserving the W1.A04 reserved/superseded meaning between W1.A03 and W1.A05. Regenerate the review page and manifest, add focused regression coverage for interleaved adopted and reserved history, preserve this adverse ledger append-only, and obtain a new independent exact-commit review before human approval.

findings.title: The generated decision surface falsely presents an approved experience reference as pending materialization
findings.reproduction: Open planning/review-site/enablers/ECR-0005.html and inspect Governed experience proposal. It says RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.5 requires human approval, that approval reserves the reference, and bootstrap must materialize its canonical approval. design/ui-reference/APPROVAL.yaml already records that exact reference as human-approved; ECR-0005 reaffirms it unchanged and its bootstrap expressly prohibits experience-reference materialization. The false text is emitted unconditionally by tools/plan_review_site.py.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant R02 candidate that distinguishes an unchanged binding to an existing approved reference from a newly proposed pending reference. For ECR-0005, state that ECR approval reaffirms and binds RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.5 without reserving or materializing it. Regenerate the review page and manifest, add focused regression coverage, preserve this adverse ledger append-only, and obtain a new independent exact-commit review before human approval.
